VBO:0200329.summary: The Chi-Poo is a Chihuahua–Poodle cross. Toy Poodles are used in documented matings.
VBO:0200329.shortDescription: A Chihuahua–Poodle cross, with documented Toy Poodle parentage.

sources.title: Cottage Canines Australia — Poochi
sources.evidence: Fresh direct breeder page explicitly defines its Poochi as Toy Poodle x Chihuahua. This supports Toy Poodle use, not a claim that all Chi-Poos use Toy Poodles or share size/coat/behavior. Prior original Oreo parent declaration independently supports Chihuahua/Poodle identity.

sources.title: Dog Breed Info — original Chi-Poo parentage captions and Poochi alias
sources.evidence: Fresh actual page read 2026-10-06: heading Chi-Poo / Chihuahua-Poodle; Mavis caption names Chihuahua mother and Poodle father, Vincent Drew keeper names Chihuahua mother and Miniature Poodle father. Other Names explicitly includes Poochi, linking Cottage Canines Frankie record. Parentage/lexical mapping only; no juvenile adult-morphology or temperament transfer.
